correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md full proof, unique-center lemma, two equivariant deformation retractions, exact 2-cell cellular presentation, and independent signed Lefschetz checker code. Pairwise edge-disjoint four-cycles imply at most two common neighbors per vertex pair and unique centers for every nonretained face; this makes barycentric replacements canonical and Γ-equivariant. Each lifted square uses distinct original double-cover edges, so ∂2 injects primitively. In the cellular Euler trace, vertices contribute 2v_gamma, oriented double-cover edges contribute 2e_gamma (both endpoints fixed), oriented filled squares contribute the signed fixed-square sum, and H0 contributes c_gamma. Hence tr H1 =c_gamma+2e_gamma−2v_gamma−sum ε, with H_{>=2}=0 and H1 torsion-free. Independent exact Euler checks on C4, C5, P5, square-plus-pentagon corroborated; source checker covers 126 qualifying Atlas isomorphism types/386 automorphism actions plus 12 extended actions. The proof supplies the universal quantifier.
residual_risks: The edge-disjoint-square hypothesis is essential; no statement for overlapping squares or equivariant irreducible integral splitting.
Component trace of bipartite double cover must be 2,0 depending on preservation/interchange of color classes, not always 2.

originality.rationale: Materially read the directly closest published Oct 11 2026 Resultary proof. It constructs exactly the nonequivariant W(G), two good-cover nerve comparisons, and square collapses giving graph wedges. That result explicitly does not state Γ-equivariant equivalences or full automorphism action. The submitted canonical equivariant barycentric retractions and signed fixed-square trace refine the known graph-like model: the ordinary homotopy ranks cannot reconstruct reflection traces. Other cited no-four-cycle equivariant and surface-quadrangulation results have different hypotheses. A possible implication via an equivariant nerve lemma and new signed-chain work is a priority/value risk, not an already stated covering theorem.
residual_risks: Very close 2026 nonequivariant precursor has the same W(G). Applying a general equivariant nerve lemma may make some representation information derivable without new topology; this could weaken perceived independence/priority.
An equivalent general signed-square representation formula might occur in older equivariant box-complex literature.

value.rationale: Determines the full first rational automorphism character of a large infinite class from fixed vertices, pointwise fixed edges, lifted square orientation and bipartition action. This genuinely refines the known nonequivariant wedge rank, including reflection signs, and supplies a natural integral short exact sequence without falsely claiming irreducible integral splitting.
residual_risks: Uses a known square-filled cell model; novelty and value rest on the uniform equivariant refinement and sign accounting, not on rediscovering the underlying Betti formula.
